changelog: Security: Mengatasi deteksi Google Play Protect dan menghapus kode yang bermasalah.
New: Menambahkan server unduhan baru untuk TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, dan Spotify.
Fixed: Perbaikan tombol Sort, Shuffle, Playlist, dan Refresh Music di Music Player.
Fixed: Perbaikan Share Nimiyo agar unduhan tidak gagal atau macet saat jendela Share ditutup lebih awal.
Fixed: Perbaikan unduhan agar muncul lengkap di riwayat unduhan (termasuk multi-gambar).
Improvements: Database playlist tersimpan lebih andal di Download/Nimiyo/Database.
Improvements: Nimiyo QuickSave lebih mulus tanpa perlu menunggu di halaman QuickSave.
Improvements: Mengurangi spam popup berlebih selama unduhan berlangsung, notifikasi realtime.
changelog_en: Security: Addressed Google Play Protect detection and removed harmful code.
New: Added new download servers for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Spotify.
Fixed: Fixed Sort button, Shuffle button, Playlist button, and Refresh Music button in Music Player.
Fixed: Fixed Share Nimiyo downloads failing or getting stuck when the Share window is closed too early.
Fixed: Fixed downloads not appearing completely in download history, including multi-images.
Improvements: Improved playlist database storage reliability in Download/Nimiyo/Database.
Improvements: Improved Nimiyo QuickSave downloads for smoother performance without waiting.
Improvements: Reduced excessive popup notifications during downloads with realtime notification.
